why: Definition of a trader: needed to tell a civil sale from a commercial one (boundary n2, section alternative, territory t3); not in the store.
Commercial acts by their object (buying movables for resale): decides whether a sale claim is commercial (boundary n2, open point o3); not in the store.
Commercial acts by form: decides whether a sale claim is commercial (boundary n2, open point o3); not in the store.
Commercial acts by accessory: to read around articles 1 to 3 for a sale made by a trader for his trade; not in the store.
